rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Special Act on the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Establishment of Implementation Plan for the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry, etc.) ① The heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall prepare implementation plans for the promotion and support of the pharmaceutical industry (hereinafter referred to as the “implementation plan” in this Article) under Article 5 , Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and submit them to the Minister of Health and Welfare by June 30 of the year preceding the year in which the implementation plan is to be implemented.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Establishment of Implementation Plan for the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry, etc.) ① The heads of relevant central administrative agencies shall prepare implementation plans for the promotion and support of the pharmaceutical industry (hereinafter referred to as the “implementation plan” in this Article) under Article 5 , Paragraph 1 of the Special Act on the Promotion and Support of the Pharmaceutical Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) and submit them to the Minister of Health and Welfare by June 30 of the year preceding the year in which the implementation plan is to be implemented.

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare shall formulate an implementation plan by consolidating and coordinating the implementation plans for each jurisdiction received pursuant to Paragraph 1, and then finalize it after deliberation by the Pharmaceutical Industry Promotion and Support Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare shall formulate an implementation plan by consolidating and coordinating the implementation plans for each jurisdiction received pursuant to Paragraph 1, and then finalize it after deliberation by the Pharmaceutical Industry Promotion and Support Committee (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”) pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies of the implementation plan finalized pursuant to Paragraph 2 by December 31 of the year preceding the year in which the implementation plan is to be implemented.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies of the implementation plan finalized pursuant to Paragraph 2 by December 31 of the year preceding the year in which the implementation plan is to be implemented.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Method, Procedure, and Notification, etc. of Certification) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall publicly announce the application period and method for the certification of innovative pharmaceutical companies pursuant to Article 7 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Certification”) at least once every two years. <Amended Oct. 24, 2013>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Method, Procedure, and Notification, etc. of Certification) ① The Minister of Health and Welfare shall publicly announce the application period and method for the certification of innovative pharmaceutical companies pursuant to Article 7 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as “Certification”) at least once every two years. <Amended Oct. 24, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ② A pharmaceutical company seeking certification pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for certification as an innovative pharmaceutical company in the form of Annex No. 1 , attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Health and Welfare during the application period announced pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended July 30, 2026>
rows.text_en: ② A pharmaceutical company seeking certification pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit an application for certification as an innovative pharmaceutical company in the form of Annex No. 1 , attached with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Minister of Health and Welfare during the application period announced pursuant to Paragraph 1. <Amended July 30, 2026>

rows.source_ko: 1. Materials proving eligibility as a pharmaceutical company or an innovative pharmaceutical company (in cases where Article 2-2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree applies, this includes materials proving that the company possesses pharmaceutical manufacturing and quality control standards that have received a conformity judgment from a government or public authority of the United States or the European Union, provided that the validity period of such materials has not expired)
rows.text_en: 1. rows.source_ko: ③ When granting certification, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall issue an Innovative Pharmaceutical Enterprise Certification in the form of Annex 2 to the pharmaceutical enterprise that applied for certification pursuant to Paragraph 2 , and shall announce the fact .
rows.text_en: ③ When granting certification, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall issue an Innovative Pharmaceutical Enterprise Certification in the form of Annex 2 to the pharmaceutical enterprise that applied for certification pursuant to Paragraph 2 , and shall announce the fact .

rows.source_ko: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed procedures and methods necessary for certification shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, detailed procedures and methods necessary for certification shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Health and Welfare .

rows.source_ko: Article 3-2 (Design of Certification Mark, etc.) ① The design and method of display of the mark indicating certification pursuant to Article 7-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Certification Mark”)are as set forth in the attached table .
rows.text_en: Article 3-2 (Design of Certification Mark, etc.) ① The design and method of display of the mark indicating certification pursuant to Article 7-2(1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Certification Mark”) are as set forth in the attached table.

rows.source_ko: ② The period of use of the certification mark shall be the validity period of the certification of an innovative pharmaceutical company pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② The period of use of the certification mark shall be the validity period of the certification of an innovative pharmaceutical company pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.text_en: [This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: Article 3-3 (Application for Succession of Status) ①An enterprise intending to apply for the succession of the status of an innovative pharmaceutical enterprise pursuant to Article 7-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare an application for succession of the status of an innovative pharmaceutical enterprise in accordance with Form No. 3-2 of the Appendix , attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs. However, documents that the Minister of Health and Welfare deems unnecessary to submit may be omitted.
rows.text_en: Article 3-3 (Application for Succession of Status) ①An enterprise intending to apply for the succession of the status of an innovative pharmaceutical enterprise pursuant to Article 7-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare an application for succession of the status of an innovative pharmaceutical enterprise in accordance with Form No. 3-2 of the Appendix , attaching the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs. However, documents that the Minister of Health and Welfare deems unnecessary to submit may be omitted.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제3조제2항 각 호의 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 3, Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 지위를 승계하려는 기업이 제3조제3항에 따라 발급받은 혁신형 제약기업 인증서
rows.text_en: 2. The certificate of innovative pharmaceutical company issued pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 to the company intending to succeed to the status

rows.source_ko: 3. 지위를 승계받으려는 기업이 지위를 승계하려는 기업의 사업 전부 또는 일부를 유지 또는 승계하였음을 증명할 수 있는 자료
rows.text_en: 3. Materials proving that the company seeking to succeed the status has maintained or succeeded to all or part of the business of the company seeking to succeed the status

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 혁신형 제약기업 지위승계를 위한 평가 방법ㆍ절차, 인증서의 발급 등은 보건복지부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine and announce the evaluation methods and procedures for the succession of the status of an innovative pharmaceutical company, the issuance of certificates, etc.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제4조(인증의 연장신청 등) ① 법 제8조제2항에 따라 인증을 연장하려는 혁신형 제약기업은 그 유효기간이 만료되기 3개월 전까지 별지 제3호서식의 혁신형 제약기업 인증 연장신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Application for Extension of Certification, etc.) ①An innovative pharmaceutical company that intends to extend its certification pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare , at least three months before the expiration of the validity period, an application for extension of certification of an innovative pharmaceutical company in the form of Annex 3 , with the following documents attached.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제3조제2항 각 호의 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents specified in each subparagraph of Article 3, Paragraph 2

rows.source_ko: 2. 제3조제3항에 따라 발급받은 혁신형 제약기업 인증서
rows.text_en: 2. Innovative Pharmaceutical Company Certificate issued pursuant to Article 3 , Paragraph 3

rows.source_ko: ② 인증을 연장하기 위한 재평가 방법ㆍ절차, 인증서의 발급 등에 관하여는 제3조제2항 및 제3항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ② The provisions of Article 3, Paragraphs 2 and 3 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the methods and procedures for re-evaluation to extend certification, and the issuance of certificates, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제5조(혁신형 제약기업의 인증취소) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제9조제1항에 따라 혁신형 제약기업의 인증을 취소하려는 경우에는 위원회의 심의를 거쳐야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Cancellation of Certification of Innovative Pharmaceutical Company) ① If the Minister of Health and Welfare intends to cancel the certification of an innovative pharmaceutical company pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she must undergo deliberation by the Committee.

rows.source_ko: ② 보건복지부장관은 제1항에 따라 인증을 취소하였을 때에는 지체 없이 그 사실을 관계 중앙행정기관의 장에게 통보하고 고시하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Health and Welfare cancels certification pursuant to Paragraph 1, he/she shall notify the heads of relevant central administrative agencies of such fact without delay and make a public announcement.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(자료 요구 절차 등) 보건복지부장관은 법 제10조제1항에 따라 자료를 요구할 때에는 그 목적ㆍ용도, 자료의 범위, 제출방법, 제출기한 등을 분명히 밝힌 문서로 하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Procedure for Requesting Data, etc.) When the Minister of Health and Welfare requests data pursuant to Article 10, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall do so in writing that clearly specifies the purpose and use, the scope of the data, the method of submission, the deadline for submission, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(국가연구개발사업 등 우선 참여의 방법 및 절차 등) ① 법 제14조에 따라 국가연구개발사업 등에 우선 참여하려는 혁신형 제약기업은 참여하려는 국가연구개발사업 등을 분명히 밝혀 보건복지부장관에게 우선 참여를 위한 조치를 신청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Method and Procedure for Priority Participation in National Research and Development Projects, etc.) ① An innovative pharmaceutical company that intends to participate in priority in national research and development projects, etc. pursuant to Article 14 of the Act may apply to the Minister of Health and Welfare for measures for priority participation by clearly specifying the national research and development project, etc. in which it intends to participate.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신청을 받은 보건복지부장관은 우선 참여의 필요성이 인정되는 경우에는 국가연구개발사업 등을 추진하는 중앙행정기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장에게 해당 혁신형 제약기업의 우선 참여를 문서로 요청하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the Minister of Health and Welfare who has received an application pursuant to Paragraph 1 recognizes the necessity of priority participation, he/she shall request in writing the head of the central administrative agency or the head of the local government promoting the national research and development project, etc., for the priority participation of the relevant innovative pharmaceutical company.

rows.source_ko: ③ 제2항에 따라 혁신형 제약기업의 우선 참여를 요청받은 중앙행정기관의 장 또는 지방자치단체의 장은 그 처리 결과를 보건복지부장관에게 문서로 통보하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The head of a central administrative agency or the head of a local government who has been requested to prioritize the participation of an innovative pharmaceutical company pursuant to Paragraph 2 shall notify the Minister of Health and Welfare of the results of the processing in writing.

rows.source_ko: ④ 보건복지부장관은 「보건의료기술 진흥법」 제5조제1항에 따른 보건의료기술 연구개발사업을 추진하는 경우에는 혁신형 제약기업을 우선 참여하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ④ When the Minister of Health and Welfare promotes a health and medical technology research and development project pursuant to Article 5, Paragraph 1 of the Health and Medical Technology Promotion Act, he/ she may allow innovative pharmaceutical companies to participate first.

rows.source_ko: 제7조의2(임상시험지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영) ① 보건복지부장관은 법 제18조의2제3항에 따라 임상시험지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영을 국내 임상시험 지원을 목적으로 「민법」 제32조에 따라 설립된 비영리기관 또는 관계 전문기관에 위탁한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7-2 (Establishment and Operation of Clinical Trial Support Centers) ① Pursuant to Article 18-2, Paragraph 3 of the Act, the Minister of Health and Welfarethe establishment and operation of clinical trial support centers to a non-profit organization established pursuant to Article 32 of the Civil Act or a relevant specialized institution for the purpose of supporting domestic clinical trials.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에서 규정한 사항 외에 임상시험지원센터의 설치ㆍ운영에 필요한 사항은 보건복지부장관이 정한다.
rows.text_en: ② In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraph 1, matters necessary for the establishment and operation of the Clinical Trial Support Center shall be determined by the Minister of Health and Welfare .
[This Article Newly Inserted June 12, 2019]

rows.source_ko: 제8조(신약 연구개발 정보관리 전문기관의 지정 요건ㆍ절차 등) ① 법 제19조제2항에 따른 신약 연구개발 관련 정보를 전문적으로 관리하는 기관(이하 “전문기관”이라 한다)의 지정 요건은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Requirements and Procedures for Designation of Specialized Institution for New Drug Research and Development Information Management) ① The requirements for designation of an institution that professionally manages information related to new drug research and development pursuant to Article 19 , Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “specialized institution”) are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 「공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률」 제4조제1항에 따른 공공기관이거나 비영리법인 또는 비영리단체일 것
rows.text_en: 1. It must be a public institution pursuant to Article 4, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions , or a non-profit corporation or non-profit organization.

rows.source_ko: 2. 신약 연구개발 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ조사 및 관리ㆍ보급에 관한 전문성을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 2. Possess expertise in the collection, investigation, management, and dissemination of information related to new drug research and development.

rows.source_ko: 3. 신약 연구개발 관련 정보의 수집ㆍ조사 및 관리ㆍ보급을 위한 인력 및 조직을 갖출 것
rows.text_en: 3. Establish personnel and organization for the collection, investigation, management, and dissemination of information related to new drug research and development.

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조제2항에 따라 전문기관으로 지정받으려는 기관 또는 단체 등은 별지 제4호서식의 신약 연구개발 정보관리 전문기관 지정신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 보건복지부장관에게 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Institutions or organizations, etc. that intend to be designated as a specialized institution pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit to the Minister of Health and Welfare an application for designation as a specialized institution for new drug research and development information management in the form of Annex 4 , attaching the documents of each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제1항제1호의 기관ㆍ단체에 해당함을 증명하는 서류
rows.text_en: 1. Documents proving eligibility as an institution or organization under Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 1

rows.source_ko: 2. 신약 연구개발 관련 정보를 수집ㆍ조사 및 관리ㆍ보급할 전담 조직, 전문 인력 및 업무수행 체계에 관한 설명서
rows.text_en: 2. Description of the dedicated organization, specialized personnel, and work execution system for collecting, investigating, managing, and disseminating information related to new drug research and development

rows.source_ko: ③ 보건복지부장관은 제2항에 따른 지정 신청이 제1항에 따른 지정 요건을 충족하는 경우에는 별지 제5호서식의 신약 연구개발 정보관리 전문기관 지정서를 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the application for designation under paragraph 2 satisfies the designation requirements under paragraph 1, the Minister of Health and Welfare shall issue a designation certificate for a specialized institution for new drug research and development information management in the form of Annex 5 .

rows.source_ko: 제9조(포상 및 지원 등) ① 법 제20조제1항에 따른 포상의 종류는 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Awards and Support, etc.) ① The types of awards pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 혁신형 제약기업 종합대상
rows.text_en: 1. Grand Prize for Innovative Pharmaceutical Companies

rows.source_ko: 2. 혁신형 제약기업 우수 부문상
rows.text_en: 2. Excellence Award for Innovative Pharmaceutical Companies

rows.source_ko: 3. Special Award for Innovative Pharmaceutical Companies
rows.text_en: 3. Special Award for Innovative Pharmaceutical Companies

rows.source_ko: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare may provide research and development expenses and training expenses, etc. to those receiving an award under Paragraph 1 pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Health and Welfare may provide research and development expenses and training expenses, etc. to those receiving an award under Paragraph 1 pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine the criteria for awards under Paragraph 1, the method and procedure for selecting recipients, etc., and announce them annually.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Health and Welfare shall determine the criteria for awards under Paragraph 1, the method and procedure for selecting recipients, etc., and announce them annually.
